description: This file provides platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware on a BMIPS-based device within the OpenWrt project. It defines a function to check the image, which always succeeds, and a function to perform the upgrade that defaults to a standard upgrade procedure unless a specific board name is matched.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image; here it always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade, delegating to default_do_upgrade unless a specific board name is provided.
